questions.q:
The health worker in hilly area will advise people to prevent which deficiency disease?

Which micronutrient is deficient in the above area?
questions.solution:
1. The health worker in a hilly area will advise people to prevent goitre, a deficiency disease caused by a lack of iodine.
  2. The micronutrient deficient in this area is iodine, as hilly regions often have iodine-deficient soil and water, leading to lower iodine intake in the diet.

questions.q: Enlist any two features of Acquired immunity.
questions.solution:
1. Specificity: It can produce a specific antibody or T-lymphocyte against a particular antigen/pathogen.
  2. Diversity: It can recognize a vast variety of diversity pathogens or foreign molecules.
  3. Discrimination between self and non-self: It differentiates between the own body (self) and foreign (non-self) molecules.
  4. Memory: When the immune system encounters a specific foreign agent for the first time, it generates an immune response and eliminates the invader. This is called a first encounter. The immune system retains the memory of the first encounter. As a result, a second encounter with the same pathogen brings about quicker.

questions.q: Explain three main functions of free antibodies produced by B-lymphocytes.
questions.solution:
Following are the main functions of free antibodies, produced by B-lymphocytes: 

  1. Agglutination of particulate matter, including bacteria and viruses. The immobilized mass is then engulfed by phagocytes.
  2. Opsonisation or coating of bacteria to facilitate their subsequent phagocytosis by macrophages.
  3. Neutralization of toxins released by bacteria e.g. tetanus toxin.
